levels.R0: Recorded source, inputs and outputs with calculated hashes.
levels.R1: Replay-ready source, inputs, command and target; local replay must still be verified.

replay.note: Website CI compares the replayed SVG byte-for-byte with this bundled figure; R1 requires seeded-randomness evidence.

figure_metadata.policy: The bundle generator normalizes the recorded SVG metadata to these calculated hashes; bundle manifest hashes are authoritative.

provenance.limits: R0 exact SVG replay is verified in website CI. The bundle does not include seeded-randomness evidence for R1, external snapshots, lockfiles, runtime captures or an R2/R3 replay guarantee.
